recommendation.headline: FIGHT this chargeback as we have robust proof of delivery with signature confirmation and buyer communication acknowledging out-for-delivery status.
recommendation.rationale: The seller has complete documentation proving fulfillment and delivery. UPS tracking confirms delivery to the buyer's exact shipping address, and carrier records show a signature by 'WHITFIELD' at the front desk on October 19, 2026. Furthermore, customer messages show the buyer acknowledged the out-for-delivery notice on the same day. With delivery and signature fully verified, the win probability is very high.

According to UPS carrier records, the package was successfully delivered on October 19, 2026, at 418 Alder St, Denver, CO 80203, and signed for by WHITFIELD at the front desk.
